epic.summary: Week 4: Memory Security, AgentOps & Live Embeddings
epic.description: Phase 2 gap remediation: replace deterministic semantic embeddings with live API when configured, add RAG poisoning defense and memory quarantine, enforce memory privilege lifecycle, expand AgentOps metrics, upgrade Critic prompts to v2.0.0 cache-eligible structure.
dependencies: DB-E10 (Week 3) complete — all four CoALA memory layers operational

decisions.scope: Live embeddings Day 1, RAG defense Day 2, quarantine Day 3, privilege lifecycle + AgentOps Day 4, Critic v2.0.0 + proof Day 5
decisions.embedding_provider: OpenRouter with openai/text-embedding-3-small; deterministic fallback for CI/offline
decisions.gaps: #58-61 AgentOps, #119 privilege retention, #120 RAG poisoning, #132 memory quarantine

tasks.description: Replace deterministic-only semantic vectors with OpenRouter embedding API when configured. Add embedding_provider settings, async embed_text_async(), Prometheus metrics, and update Focus/retrieval call sites.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic fallback preserved for tests and offline dev
Focus agent and retrieve_agent_memory use embed_text_async

tasks.description: Pre-ingestion validation for semantic memory: injection pattern scan, content provenance metadata, retrieval sanitization before LLM injection.
acceptance_criteria: Malicious patterns rejected with security_violations metric

tasks.description: Quarantine suspected poisoned memory segments: freeze retrieval, flag metadata, alert on quarantine action, review restore/delete workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Quarantined rows excluded from semantic and episodic retrieval
memory_quarantine_total metric and audit log entry on quarantine

tasks.description: Sanitize privileges from episodic memory, enforce session-bound privilege TTL, add consensus_disagreement and memory_consolidation metrics, orchestrator post-session distillation hook.
acceptance_criteria: Episodic lessons redact credential/privilege patterns before store
Privilege grants stored in past tense with session expiry
Orchestrator calls distill_working_to_episodic at session end
